items.title: Letter calls for patient needs to be prioritised over cost in continence care
items.summary: Continence care must be driven by patient needs and outcomes instead of costs, an open letter signed by the Royal College of Nursing (RCN) and others has urged.

items.title: Nurses, charities and MPs band together in continence campaign
items.summary: The Royal College of Nursing has joined with a group of leading charities to call for the NHS to put patients before price in purchasing decisions on continence care.

items.title: East of England Collaborative Procurement Hub — Market Engagement Stoma Care Nurse Sponsorship (C488970)
items.summary: EoECPH currently own a Stoma Care Nurse Sponsorship framework that launched in 2023 and is due to expire on 30th April 2027. The framework was set up following research on the East of England region's stoma care services, outlined in the StoMap Baseline Report.

items.title: Market Engagement for Stoma Care Nurse Sponsorship Services
items.summary: East of England NHS collaborative Procurement Hub. EoECPH would like to approach the marketplace to gather market intelligence around a new framework for Stoma Care Nurse Sponsorship Services.
